title: Hotpatch: private VPC SSO role-mapping fallback + KMS rotation race causing missing audit events
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple customers on Private (VPC) reported that after a recent IdP update they could access resources they should not have. Investigation shows a SAML assertion attribute change caused our role-mapping fallback to assign an internal default role, which combined with an in-flight KMS key rotation edge case caused ~10% of request audits to be written without tenant metadata. Missing tenant metadata made audit rows effectively opaque and triggered customer escalations. This ticket tracks the urgent patch: 1) eliminate unsafe role-mapping fallback, 2) serialize KMS rotation with audit writes, and 3) a backfill to restore missing audit context where possible.
acceptance_criteria: No new SSO assertions result in fallback-to-default-role behavior in private deployments after hotpatch
Audit events created during KMS rotations include tenant metadata for 100% of new requests (no regression)
Backfill job restores contextual metadata for >90% of missing audit events where keys are available
Patch deployed to canary subset in private-prod, monitored for 48h, then staged rollout to remaining customers
Automated unit and integration tests added to cover role mapping and KMS rotation race conditions
reproduction_steps: 1) Deploy private stack with test IdP that omits 'roles' attribute for some assertions
2) Trigger SAML login, observe RBAC mapping logic - current fallback assigns 'workspace:viewer' instead of rejecting/flagging
3) Start a KMS rotation (rotate tenant data key) while generating requests that write audits
4) Query audit table for events during rotation window and observe missing tenant_id and role fields in ~10% of rows
mitigation_taken: Applied temporary guardrail in control plane to block IdP updates that remove role attributes (config flag) - emergency change 2026-03-11
Notified affected customers and enabled enhanced logging on their private clusters
Increased audit retention and snapshot exports to S3 for forensic analysis
proposed_fix: A. Change RBAC mapper: treat missing role attributes as 'mapping error' and deny token mapping until explicit mapping exists; never auto-assign workspace-wide defaults
B. Introduce KMS rotation lock: before rotating, acquire rotation-lock, quiesce audit writes for affected tenant or buffer writes and atomically re-encrypt after rotation
C. Add transactional envelope to audit writes: attach cached tenant metadata signed by control plane and validate post-rotation
D. Backfill: run a job that attempts to re-associate missing audit events using S3 snapshots, logs, and sequence numbers; produce a remediation report per customer
rollout_plan: 2) Run unit/integration tests in CI; deploy to internal staging clusters
3) Canary deploy to 3 smallest private customers (non-critical) with monitoring on audit integrity and auth flows for 48h
4) If canary stable, incrementally rollout to remaining customers in groups of 5, with 2-hour watch windows
5) Post-rollout: run backfill on affected tenants after patch lands; publish remediation reports
testing_plan: Unit tests for RBAC mapper: missing 'roles' vs empty list vs malformed assertion
Integration test simulating concurrent KMS rotation and audit write to reproduce race in CI
Chaos test: random IdP attribute changes to ensure mapper fails-safe
E2E smoke on canary tenants: authenticate, exercise write path, verify audit rows include tenant_id/role
Load test to validate rotation-lock does not cause significant latency under 95th percentile
rollback_plan: If canary shows >1% new audit misses or auth failures, rollback to previous runtime image and re-enable emergency guardrail
Revert PR #GH-12234 and trigger redeploy to canary within 30 minutes
If backfill yields data corruption, pause backfill and run targeted manual remediation with SRE support
follow_up_tasks: 1) Post-incident RCA doc in Confluence summarizing root cause and timeline
2) Add metric to SLI dashboard for 'audit rows missing tenant metadata' and set alert threshold
3) Update Private deployment upgrade guide to include KMS rotation pre-checks
4) Security review for RBAC mapping change and update threat model
5) Customer communications draft for affected tenants and legal if required
